hero.subtitle: Learnyx Academy ET 🇪🇹 is the complete content library for the EHEEE (Ethiopian Higher Education Entrance Examination, also called ESSLCE) — textbooks, past papers, worksheets and study guides across all nine subjects. Sign in, search the catalog, and download exactly what your grade and stream require.
hero.trustLine3: free to browse, premium to download

companion.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't.
companion.subtitle: Learnyx brings together every tool a grade 9–12 student needs for the EHEEE — organized, focused, and built for the way you actually study.
companion.sectionSubtitle: An adaptive learning engine — not a website. Plans build your roadmap, flashcards find your weaknesses, notes answer your questions, and the calendar runs your day. Every piece feeds the next.

features.title: AI tutor that knows your syllabus
features.description: AI-powered tutor grounded in the real curriculum. It remembers your stream, your hard subjects and every conversation.

features.title: Quick-check quizzes
features.description: AI writes exam-style questions from your subject's topics. Answer one at a time, get instant feedback, watch scores trend on your journey.

features.title: AI Study Commander
features.description: Tell Learnyx your exam date and available study time. It builds a week-by-week roadmap with exam-critical topics first, tracks whether you're on track, and reorganizes the plan if you fall behind.

features.title: Focus timer + streaks
features.description: Log every session. Streaks, hours and per-subject history build up on your dashboard — and reminders nudge you before the streak breaks.

features.title: Notes with AI enhancement
features.description: Write messy notes, tap Enhance, and the AI restructures them into clean study material. Ask My Notes searches everything you've written and answers from your own notes.

features.title: Study-vibe sound mixer
features.description: 25 synthesized ambient tracks across 6 categories, plus classical pieces by Bach and Mozart. Layer multiple sounds, save custom mixes, or paste a YouTube study playlist.

features.title: Full mock exams under real conditions
features.description: AI generates ~340 original questions across all 6 EHEEE subjects — 50 min per section, no pausing, auto-graded per subject with progress tracking across attempts.

features.title: Study squads
features.description: Private groups with a shared invite code — live video rooms, group chat, and a weekly leaderboard that ranks real study effort, not guesswork.

features.title: Levels & achievements
features.description: Real XP for real study — streaks, badges, and a level that actually reflects the work you've put in, not just time spent.

features.title: Smart flashcards with spaced repetition
features.description: Generate decks from any textbook page while you read. Smart Spaced Repetition schedules each card's next review. Weakness Hunter finds what you keep forgetting. Exam Attack mode tests you under pressure.

features.title: Your journey, tracked honestly
features.description: Real progress charts, quiz trends, and the connections between topics across your subjects — no vanity metrics, just where you actually are.

features.title: Calendar as your daily OS
features.description: Today's Mission shows what to study and for how long. Exam countdown ticks down to your next test. Study blocks from your AI plan land here automatically, with daily study load per subject.

aiTutor.title: AI Tutor
aiTutor.description: Ask any question, get an answer in seconds. Available 24/7, never gets impatient, always explains the way you need it.

mockExams.title: Mock Exams
mockExams.description: Full-length practice exams with real exam timing, instant scoring, and detailed explanations for every question.

flashcards.title: Smart Flashcards
flashcards.description: Generate from any textbook page. Spaced repetition schedules each card. Weakness Hunter finds what you forget. Exam Attack tests you under pressure.

aptitude.title: Aptitude Hub
aptitude.description: SAT-style reasoning practice with a brain-map that shows exactly which skills you've mastered and which need work.

library.title: Textbook Library
library.description: Every textbook, past exam, and worksheet — organized by subject, grade, and unit. Searchable, bookmarkable, downloadable.

groups.title: Study Groups
groups.description: Private rooms for your class or friends. Chat, share notes, jump into live video sessions, and stay motivated together.

streams.title: Two streams, one national exam
streams.subtitle: English, Mathematics and the SAT are sat by every candidate — they're part of both tracks. Pick your stream and the library is already organized around your exam subjects.

libraryTypes.title: Five resource types, one search
libraryTypes.subtitle: From full textbooks to real past papers — filter and search by grade, subject and type in seconds.

howItWorks.title: From sign-in to exam room in three steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No setup, no waiting. Pick your stream and grade, and you're studying.

steps.title: Sign in and pick your stream
steps.description: Create an account in seconds — email, Google or guest. Choose natural, social or common and the AI organizes your dashboard around your exam subjects.

steps.title: Study with the companion
steps.description: Search the library, open past papers, chat with the tutor, run quizzes, plan your weeks and pin notes — every action feeds your real progress.

steps.title: Watch your journey
steps.description: Streaks, hours, quiz scores and topic completion, charted honestly. Premium unlocks past exams, plans and unlimited tutoring.

step1.title: Sign up free
step1.description: Use your email or Google account. Get 14 active days of premium access as a trial — no card required.

step2.title: Pick your stream
step2.description: Natural or Social Science — we'll show you the right subjects and resources automatically.

step3.title: Start studying
step3.description: Open the library, ask the AI tutor a question, take a mock exam, or start a flashcard deck. That's it.

cta.title1: Ready to walk into the exam room
cta.subtitle: Create your free account and get instant access to every textbook, past paper and study guide for your stream — organized by grade and subject. Free covers the library, todos, the focus timer, streaks, 15 tutor messages a day and a weekly quiz. Premium adds unlimited tutoring, unlimited quizzes and AI study plans when you're ready.

footer.tagline: Built for Ethiopian students, by Ethiopian developers.
